# An invoice paid by a block stating `payment_split_guid:`, the key's old name.
#
# The key is `txn_split_guid:` now. Read as an unknown key, the old one would
# be ignored, and the payment would be recorded from its date and amount
# instead of on the split it states, so the import refuses it and says the new
# name.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the invoice.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_the_old_payment_split_guid_key_is_refused.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-OLD-KEY"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-OLD-KEY"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-15
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Payment INV-OLD-KEY"
		payment_split_guid: "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
